title: Flimsy but useful temporarily
text: Flimsy but useful temporarily. I have bought about one doen of these from various places - the first several from Walmart, the last one here.They are okay for a FEW items of clothing but bend or fall voer if overloaded. The metal actually bends into an arc. What I have done in my garage sale clothing area is wire them to something else an to each other to keep them stable. These are okay for temporary LIGHT clothing storage, they go together easily and quickly and look nice, BUT,just be aware that for heavier long term storage heavier duty item is better.

product_metadata.title: Honey-Can-Do Portable Metal Clothes Rack with Bottom Shelf, White GAR-09069 White 30 lbs
features: Sleek, simple solution to expand closet capacity, display outfits, and more
Sturdy epoxy-coated steel construction resists rust
Bottom rack stores shoes, bags, or storage bins
Rolling caster wheels (two locking) for easily moving between rooms
description: A portable clothes rack is one of our most versatile organizational products. In the bedroom, use it to instantly expand a closet’s capacity (without having to demo walls or apply for building permits). Or set it up near a full-length mirror to hang fun combinations and stylish ensembles for a week of outfit planning. In the laundry room, this portable metal clothes rack can line-dry shirts and other delicate garments. And if you roll it to an entryway on its four caster wheels, then you have a quick coat rack with a space on the bottom shelf for boots, bags, or any other items you grab on the go.
